subject: Telemetry ownership spike: map per-route billing signals to owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Telemetry ownership spike: map per-route billing signals to owners

Hi team,

Quick ask from Product: we want a lightweight spike (3–5 days) to identify the minimal set of telemetry signals needed to attribute per-route billing and latency to owning teams. Key outcomes:
- A small ownership matrix (route -> owner + fallback)
- A recommended retention window for per-route traces and token-level billing to support 90/95th latency digs
- One sample export from a customer (anonymized) showing route labels used in production

Two constraints: 
1) Keep the instrumentation changes minimal (prefer derived joins in Observability rather than instrumenting new fields).
2) Billing folks want a deterministic mapping so we can roll out a chargeback pilot next quarter.

I've attached a starter ownership matrix and a redacted sample export from Acme for reference. Can you confirm feasibility and estimate effort? If this is doable, I'd like a short kickoff doc and an owner assigned for rollout.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: per-route-ownership-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), acme-sample-export.json (json)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry ownership spike: map per-route billing signals to owners

Marissa — thanks for the summary and attachments. Quick thoughts:

- Feasibility: yes, we can get a useful mapping without schema changes by linking route_id + model_variant + tenant_id to an ownership table and deriving cost attribution in the console.
- Retention: for initial spike I'd propose keeping per-route traces at 14 days and token-level billing aggregates at 90 days (aggregate only). That preserves the ability to compute p95 for recent incidents while keeping storage under control.
- Effort estimate: 3 engineers (1 infra, 1 backend, 1 console) for a 5-day spike to produce a PRD + a prototype view.

Questions before I set owners:
1) Is billing ok with 14d trace retention for triage? (they asked for 30d but that increases cost).
2) Do we need a canonical route_id? Acme's sample has mixed route labels (stringified paths + descriptor).

I'll tentatively assign Karthik to lead the spike with Soojin as console lead, unless you want someone else. If that's fine, I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Technical Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry ownership spike: map per-route billing signals to owners

Thanks for looping us in. A couple clarifications from Acme:
- We currently attach a user-facing route name and an internal route_key; the internal key is what truly maps to product teams. We can share a small export with both fields.
- For retention: 14 days for full traces is fine for us for the pilot. We can prepare a week of labeled traffic for the spike.

One ask: when you build the ownership matrix, can you include a fallback tag (e.g., product:ops) for routes that are duplicated across teams? That helps our internal chargeback reconciliation.

Happy to join the kickoff if it helps.

—Sarah
Sarah Lee
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Platform

Forwarded-For-Visibility: GCP Marketplace <marketplace-team@gcloud.com>

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Telemetry ownership spike: map per-route billing signals to owners

All — quick update after syncing with infra and console:

Action items (5-day spike):
1) Infra (Anita) will produce a derived join that emits owner_id for route_id where we have a clear mapping (2 days).
2) Backend (me) will add a lightweight aggregation to produce daily per-route billing rollups (p50/p95/token_count) scoped to last 14 days (3 days).
3) Console (Soojin) will spin up a prototype tile that shows route -> owner, recent p95 latency, and a cost column that reads from rollups (3 days).
4) Product (Marissa) will provide the canonical fallback owner list and prioritize top-50 routes for the pilot.

Deliverables by end of next week: PRD, ownership_matrix.xlsx (updated), prototype console tile demo, and anonymized sample export (Acme).

I'll kick off a short Confluence doc and create a channel in #product-observability for coordination. Can everyone confirm owners below?
- Spike lead: Karthik Iyer
- Console prototype: Soojin Lee
- Product liaison: Marissa Cole
- Customer sample: Sarah Lee / Acme

If no objections, I'll schedule daily 20-minute check-ins starting Monday.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Backend Serving | Redwood Inference
